newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia suffers sharp drop in coffee output.
newsitem.headline: Colombia suffers sharp drop in coffee output.

text.p: Colombia produced 6,570,000 60- kilo bags of green coffee between January and August 1996, 12.8 percent less than the 7,535,000 bags produced during the same period last year, statistics from the National Coffee Growers Federation show.
The official production figures underscore the damage done by unusually heavy rains earlier this year.

In addition to foul weather, growers say the 1996 crop has been hurt by soaring production costs, including those associated with fighting the berry borer -- a plague that threatens to ravish trees across the country.
The National Coffee Growers Federation has estimated total production for the 1996 calendar year at 10.5 million 60-kilo bags, down from 13.6 million in 1995.
Production in August 1996 totalled 620,000 60-kilo bags, down from 760,000 bags in August 1995, according to the figures made available by the Federation's Division of Economic Investigations.
